scenario: Lin took approved medical leave beginning January 6. She notified HR of her intended return and submitted a fitness-for-duty certificate. Her manager has asked whether her old position must be held for her.
policy: An employee on approved medical leave is entitled to job-protected reinstatement to their same position upon return, provided the leave does not exceed 12 weeks. Leave exceeding 12 weeks forfeits the reinstatement guarantee.
question: Is Lin entitled to job-protected reinstatement to her same position?
